description:
Discover an exclusive boutique off-plan development of apartments for sale in Fuengirola, comprising just 36 contemporary homes with breathtaking views over the Mediterranean Sea. Ideally located in Torreblanca on the Costa del Sol, this new residential project is designed for buyers who appreciate tranquillity, modern design, and a high-quality coastal lifestyle, while remaining well connected to local amenities and transport links.

The development offers a carefully considered selection of one-, two- and three-bedroom off-plan apartments, along with a limited number of luxury penthouses in Fuengirola featuring expansive sea-view terraces. Each home is thoughtfully designed with open-plan interiors, large-format flooring, soft neutral colour palettes, and generous outdoor spaces that maximise natural light and create a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. The elevated positioning ensures many apartments enjoy uninterrupted panoramic views of the coastline.

Kitchens are elegantly designed and come fully equipped with premium appliances, while built-in wardrobes, dressing areas in selected units, and efficient hot and cold air conditioning systems provide everyday comfort and functionality. Floor-to-ceiling glazing enhances the sense of space and allows the Mediterranean light and sea views to take centre stage. All residences benefit from private underground parking and lift access, ensuring convenience and accessibility throughout the building.

Set within a secure gated community, this boutique off-plan development in Fuengirola offers beautifully landscaped Mediterranean gardens, a resort-style swimming pool with sunbathing areas, and a fully equipped indoor gym. The peaceful residential setting makes it ideal for year-round living or relaxing holidays, while still being just minutes from the beach, Torreblanca train station, and a variety of local cafés, shops, and services. The popular areas of Los Boliches and central Fuengirola are close by, as is the Michelin-starred Sollo restaurant, with Málaga Airport, Marbella, and Puerto Banús all easily accessible by car or train.

Whether you are looking for a stylish new home in Fuengirola, a holiday apartment on the Costa del Sol, or a high-potential off-plan property investment, this development offers an excellent combination of location, design, and long-term value. The limited number of residences, combined with strong demand for new build apartments in Fuengirola, makes this an attractive opportunity for both lifestyle buyers and investors alike.

This is more than just an off-plan apartment development; it is a lifestyle defined by light, space, and Mediterranean calm. Register your interest today to receive full details on availability, floor plans, and early pricing, and secure your place in one of the most appealing new developments currently available in Fuengirola.
